title: Tavelo Grow | Shop Demo Bike

takeaways.text: The frame is designed for electronic groupsets; the dealer had to modify the frame and headset top cap to route a mechanical GRX gear cable and advises against doing so.
On 25 mm-internal wheels a 2.25 in Thunder Burt (about 57 mm) fitted the fork and a 2.10 in (about 54 mm) fitted the rear; he would not go any bigger.
The supplied seatpost is long and stops where the frame narrows, so expect to cut it; the dealer echoed another owner's finding.
The UK dealer orders directly from Tavelo with about two to three weeks' shipping and had most sizes in every colour (August 2026).

disclosure: Published by Woods Cycles, a UK Tavelo dealer, about its own demo bike.
summary: UK dealer walkaround of its size-L Tavelo Grow demo bike built with mechanical GRX and large-volume tires.
